retention.title: Tarihleri ne kadar sakla?
retention.textHint: Daha eski girdiler otomatik olarak silinir. Metin varsayılan olarak her zaman korunur.

choices.title: Gizlilik seçenekleri
choices.contextHint: Sadece söylenirken yakındaki metni oku, isimler ve yazım için tanıyı yap. Kontekst kaydedilmez veya kaydedilmez.

choices.learnHint: Bir dictation yapıştırıldıktan sonra, o metin kutusunda düzelttiğiniz kelimeleri dikkate alarak Sözlük'te önerin. Sadece düzelttikten sonra kalan kelime saklanmaz veya kaydedilmez.

export.title: Verileriniz

export.failed: Verilerinizin dışa aktarılması başarısız oldu. Herhangi bir şey silinmedi.

delete.title: Tüm verilerinizi silmek istiyor musunuz?
delete.warning: Bu, tarih, kayıtlar, ayarlar, loglar ve çöküş raporlarını kalıcı olarak siler. Bu işlem geri alınamaz.
delete.relaunch: Wispr Bro çalışmasını durduracak, verileri silip onboarding'a dönecektir.
delete.modelsHint: Bu seçeneği kapalı tutun çünkü konuşma ve temizleme modellerini tekrar indirmek istemeyebilirsiniz.

intro.title: Make your writing say it the way you mean it
intro.body: Select text in any app and press a shortcut. A transform rewrites it in place, right on this Mac.

original.name: Original
original.text: so basically i wanted to check if we could maybe push the review to thursday because the numbers arent ready and also sam is away

polish.name: Polish
polish.text: Could we move the review to Thursday? The numbers aren't ready yet, and Sam is away.

prompt.name: Prompt Engineer
prompt.text: Write a short, friendly note asking to move the review to Thursday. Reasons: the numbers aren't ready and Sam is away. Keep it to two sentences.

benefits.label: What a transform can do
benefits.order: Puts points in a better order
benefits.anywhere: Works in any app you write in

practice.title: Select the text, then press {{shortcut}}
practice.body: Select the message below (⌘A selects all of it), then press the Polish shortcut.
practice.doneBody: Press {{view}} to view the changes. {{undo}} undoes it.
practice.context: Are we still on for the review tomorrow?
practice.draft: hey so i think we should probably move the review to thursday if thats ok because the numbers arent really ready yet and i dont want to show half finished stuff

example.polish: Could we move the review to Thursday? The numbers aren't ready yet, and I'd rather not show unfinished work.
example.prompt: Write a short, polite reply asking to move tomorrow's review to Thursday because the numbers aren't ready. Keep it friendly and under three sentences.

practice.exampleNote: Rewriting is not ready on this Mac yet, so this shows an example. Once it is, your shortcut rewrites your own text the same way.
practice.selectFirst: Select some of the message first, then press {{shortcut}} again.
practice.spotlight: After every transform, the bar at the bottom of your screen offers View changes. Click it or press {{view}}.

select.title: Select text in any app
select.body: Write or dictate as usual: an email, a chat, a document. Then select what you want rewritten.
select.scene: Animation: a draft email is selected.

press.title: Press {{shortcut}}
press.body: Polish rewrites the selection in place. Prompt Engineer ({{prompt}}) turns it into a clear prompt for an AI assistant.
press.scene: Animation: {{shortcut}} is pressed and the draft is replaced with a clearer version.

changes.title: See what changed
changes.body: Press {{view}} or click View changes on the bar: removed words are struck out, new ones highlighted. {{undo}} puts your original back.
changes.scene: Animation: a card lists the changes, removed words struck out and new words highlighted.

scene.draft: hi all just a quick note that the launch is moving to next week because we found a bug in the payment flow and want to fix it first
scene.polished: Hi all, the launch is moving to next week. We found a bug in the payment flow and want to fix it first.

soft.title: A soft voice is enough
soft.body: You don't have to speak up. Whisper, and your words still turn into clean text, so you can dictate in an open office, on a train or while someone sleeps nearby.
soft.spoken: “remind me to send the slides before lunch and book a room for friday”
soft.text: Remind me to send the slides before lunch and book a room for Friday.
soft.scene: Animation: a whispered sentence appears as typed text: “{{text}}”

how.title: How to whisper to your Mac
how.body: With the microphone built into your Mac, four habits make a quiet voice easy to hear.
how.distance: About 30 cm, roughly a forearm, from the microphone

distance.title: Sit close.
distance.body: Face your Mac at about a forearm's length. Leaning in a little helps more than speaking louder.

breath.title: Whisper with some breath.
breath.body: Not the faintest whisper: a little firmer, as if talking to someone across a small table.

pace.title: Keep a steady pace.
pace.body: Say each word fully and don't let the ends of sentences fade away.

release.title: Let go last.
release.body: Release the key only after your last word, so it is kept.

practice.title: Whisper this email
practice.body: A real take: it lands in the drawn message below and nowhere else.
practice.doneTitle: Heard you, even in a whisper
practice.doneBody: That is all it takes. Continue to find the microphone that suits you.
practice.instruction: Hold {{key}}, whisper the email below, then let go.
practice.unbound: No dictation shortcut is set, so a take can't start here. Skip this step for now and set a shortcut in Settings.
practice.sentence: Hi Sam, I'm in a quiet room, so I'm whispering this email. Could we move our call to the afternoon? Thanks a lot.

status.idle: Waiting for you to hold {{key}} and whisper…
status.listening: Listening… let go of {{key}} when you're done.
status.nothing: Nothing came through. Check that your microphone is on, then try again.
status.low: {{percent}}% of the words came through. Try once more:
status.example: This is an example of a whispered take.

practice.exampleNote: Speech recognition is still being set up on this Mac, so this shows an example. Your own take is saved in History and is written down as soon as setup finishes.

tips.title: A few things help
tips.closer: Move a little closer to your Mac, about 30 cm away.
tips.firmer: Whisper a bit firmer, with more breath behind the words.
tips.volume: Raise the input volume in System Settings › Sound › Input.

built_in.name: Built-in microphone
built_in.hint: Already in your laptop or iMac
built_in.why: It is already there; sit close and it does the job at home.

wired_headset.name: Wired headset
wired_headset.hint: A mic on a short arm or cable, close to your mouth
wired_headset.why: The mic sits right by your mouth, so even a soft whisper comes through, wherever you are.

wireless_earbuds.name: Wireless earbuds
wireless_earbuds.hint: Earbuds with a microphone, no cable
wireless_earbuds.why: Nothing to plug in and they go everywhere with you.

desk_usb.name: Desk or USB mic
desk_usb.hint: A microphone that stands on your desk
desk_usb.why: The clearest sound when you work at one desk and sit close to it.

comfortable.title: Pick a microphone you'd be comfortable using
comfortable.body: All of them work. Choose the one you'd happily wear or keep on your desk.

workplace.title: Where do you usually work?
workplace.body: Whispering matters most when people are close by.

private.label: Somewhere private
private.hint: A home office or a room to yourself

mixed.label: A bit of both
mixed.hint: Sometimes alone, sometimes with people around

shared.label: Around other people
shared.hint: An open office, a café, a shared room

moves.title: Do you move between places?
moves.body: A microphone that travels with you helps if you do.

owned.title: Which microphones do you have?
owned.body: Pick every one you have. A Mac mini or Mac Studio has no microphone of its own.

results.title: Your microphone match
results.body: Based on your answers. Nothing is saved or sent anywhere.
results.caption: How each kind of microphone does
results.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the table and copy it instead.
